question: Within the actual PIT CHINEXT candidates that pass the frozen RS-acceleration veto, which economically distinct descriptors may improve same-date capital allocation?
honesty_boundary: The candidate domain, 15 descriptors, economic orientations, outcome construction, and marginal diagnostics are fixed before this script's accepted panel and scan are viewed. All 2018-2023 rows are consumed development history.

candidate_domain.source: ENTRY_SIGNAL_EVALUATED rows from the accepted RS-veto engine replays
candidate_domain.baseline_admission: price structure passed, minvol.passed is true, and rs is present
candidate_domain.frozen_component: exclude r20-r120 >= 0.20 using exact decimal comparison
candidate_domain.baseline_rank: descending existing rs.score, then mom60, then symbol
candidate_domain.selected_status: exact new-position fills in the accepted RS-veto execution ledgers

outcome_contract.primary: 20th trading-session close total return from next-session raw open, net 10 bps at entry and hypothetical mark-to-exit
outcome_contract.neighbor: 5th trading-session close return under the same construction
outcome_contract.next_open: requires hard_valid, tradable, finite positive raw open, and buy_blocked_open is false
outcome_contract.corporate_actions: apply visible valid cash/share actions before the effective-session bar; fail closed on rights, blocking, invalid, or unavailable action
outcome_contract.predictor_boundary: all outcome/path fields are attribution targets and never model inputs

diagnostics: overall and two-block Spearman rank association
oriented top/middle/bottom thirds with mean, median, win, winner-20 and severe-loss rates
same-date Top-1 economics on dates with at least two candidates
pairwise redundancy against existing rs.score and other descriptors
prohibited: changing or retesting the 0.20 veto threshold
outcome or future-path fields as predictors
broad-universe prediction outside the actual candidate set
automatic feature combinations or threshold search
